U.note: Tidy dark pill nav that opens a compact six-tile bento with a bag stepper and roast picker, but sparse content and small tiles.

V.note: Rich bento with working roast, subscription and cafe controls and a visible state readout, though dense and a little debug-looking.

W.note: Bold Kiln and Kettle branding and a floating bento panel with working controls, but the panel covers the hero text and is fairly small on a cramped layout.

X.note: Clean full-width bento with featured blend, categories, order list, milk options and a running total; cohesive and usable, with a blank page at rest.

Y.note: Most complete and polished bento: expanding tiles, roast and subscription toggles, bag, cafe select, with Escape and outside-click close and a cohesive palette.

Z.note: Stacked-tins concept with playful tilted tiles and a distinctive look, but the tiles are small and mobile puts the menu below the hero.
